newsitem.title: BARBADOS: CRICKET-INDIA COLLAPSE CHASING ONLY 120 TO WIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA COLLAPSE CHASING ONLY 120 TO WIN.

text.p: West Indies were on the verge of a remarkable victory on the fourth day of the third test on Monday as India, chasing just 120, were reduced to 62 for seven at lunch.

The pace trio of Franklyn Rose, Curtly Ambrose and Ian Bishop ripped through the Indian batting to leave the tourists still needing 58 runs. Wicket-keeper Nayan Mongia, on three, and fast bowler Dodda Ganesh, 2, were at the crease.
Rose has so far captured three for 19 off nine overs. Ambrose has two for 28 off 10 overs and Bishop two for 15 in seven.
West Indies had been dismissed for 140, leaving India two days to reach the target and claim just their third win in 31 tests in the Caribbean.
